_criterion: Every firm whose rules are verified from its own primary documents appears, alphabetical, no cap. A firm is added when verification completes, never before. Bitfunded is the reference firm because it was verified first and most completely. Selection of which firms to verify next follows verified-review volume on propfirmmatch.com/crypto — an external, public ranking whose methodology discloses its affiliate model and states rankings cannot be bought — with their own stated limitation: higher volume does not automatically mean better.
_order: alphabetical, always. No ranking, no score, no recommended badge.
_disclosure: troid is an affiliate of every firm listed. Where a code is shown, it's cheaper through us; where it isn't, it's the same price. Commission structures differ. We compute; you choose.
_rule: A firm goes on the comparison only when every field below is verified from the firm's own primary documents (ToU + help centre, checked against each other) and the verified_from URLs are recorded. A null field means not yet verified, and the firm stays off the page.

_what_troid_compares: What each firm's rules cost the reader at the reader's own sizing: room before the max loss binds, where the ceilings swap, losses survivable, fee drag, liquidation distance. Directory attributes - country, years, reviews, promos - are propfirmmatch's table, not ours. The two are complementary: they compare firms; we compare outcomes.
_bitfunded_directory_note: Bitfunded is not listed on propfirmmatch's crypto directory (checked 2026-09-21). The reference-firm standing is about verification depth, not directory rank.
_link_rule: A firm's link shows when link_live is true in its entry AND daily, max, target and price are verified from the firm's own documents. link_live is set by a human when the affiliate agreement exists and its conditions for linking are met. Other cells show 'pending' individually. US availability is always shown as its own row.
_schema_note: Field set borrows from propfirmmatch's per-firm schema (integration/execution type, restricted countries, payment and payout methods, dated rule changes) and adds what they leave empty: the rules themselves, and the computation against the reader's own sizing.
_disclaimer_rule: Generic disclosure text lives in the pages and never names a firm. Anything firm-specific is generated from this file by gen_compare.py: the firms panel on the landing page, and every listed firm's required_disclaimer in the FAQ disclaimer and both footers. Adding or removing a firm is one edit here and one daily run.
